# The recorded medians of the scale test of a pull request (ADR-0040 item 5, SDN-18 #194): the scenario of
# controller/internal/nodesim/scale.go at a tenth of the target, 1,000 nodes, 100 VRFs and 10,000 routes,
# as .github/scripts/bench-gate.py reads them: <case> <median> <unit> <margin %>.
# The step Performance regression gate at a tenth of the target of the job scale in ranz.yml compares the BENCH lines of each run
# with them.
# bench-gate.py record makes this file from the scale-bench*.txt files of the artifact ranz-scale-pr of several CI runs.
# Recorded by bench-gate.py record from the three files of one run of the job scale (ubuntu-24.04, 4 CPUs), 41322803714 on pull
# request 603, which hold the three changes of every VRF, the margin twice the slowest file's distance from the median, rounded up
# to 5 %, and at least 100 %: a change takes 1 to 2 seconds here and the slowest of the three takes 78 % longer than the fastest, so
# a run twice as slow as its median is a regression and not a noisy runner. The gate judges the best of the three changes of a
# run. Record them again from more runs (each night makes one) to narrow the margins.
